settings.subtitle: Simply Being, Fully Living.
settings.paragraph_1: Founded in Vietnam in 2026, PHAM is an independent design label built around restraint, proportion and controlled detail.
settings.paragraph_2: Each object is developed as a focused edition rather than a seasonal volume exercise. From silhouette and material selection to sampling and final production, decisions are kept deliberate and traceable so the finished garment remains coherent with the original intent.

settings.title: FORM BEFORE NOISE
settings.body: Every line must carry purpose before it carries attention.

settings.title: RESTRAINT AS FORCE
settings.body: Identity is built through proportion, material and controlled detail.

settings.title: ONE OBJECT AT A TIME
settings.body: Each edition is developed slowly, documented completely and released deliberately.

settings.title: DETAIL WITHOUT DISPLAY
settings.body: Identity lives in construction, proportion and hidden detail rather than oversized branding.
